variants.headline: Looking back: illness spreads beyond the clinics' reach
variants.sub: The pandemic has left {sick} people unable to work; {district} is the worst affected district.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: Illness was spreading, with {sick} people too ill to work and {district} worst affected.

A political principle ought to have something to say to someone who is ill. Our movement believes care belongs within the colony's common responsibilities. The purpose of public life cannot be reduced to an argument over who deserves praise while the need for treatment remains the central practical question.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

The role of {target} deserves scrutiny against the shortage of treatment. This paper's standard is the practical provision of care, with the needs of ill people kept at the centre of the assessment.

variants.headline: Looking back: pandemic leaves {sick} too ill to work
variants.sub: The worst affected district is {district}, while illness leaves {sick} people unable to work.
variants.body:
Looking back to {first_reported}, this was the news: The pandemic had left {sick} people unable to work; {district} was the worst affected district.

A political principle ought to have something to say to someone who is ill. Our movement believes care belongs within the colony's common responsibilities. The purpose of public life cannot be reduced to an argument over who deserves praise while the need for treatment remains the central practical question.

Time changes the distance from an event, not the need to judge it carefully. Any claim about improvement or deterioration needs more than a recollection of the original news.

variants.headline: Looking back: {district} bears the worst of the pandemic
variants.sub: Illness is spreading, with {sick} people too ill to work and {district} worst affected.
variants.body:
The headline belongs to {first_reported}. Our original account recorded this: The worst affected district was {district}, while illness leaves {sick} people unable to work.

A political principle ought to have something to say to someone who is ill. Our movement believes care belongs within the colony's common responsibilities. The purpose of public life cannot be reduced to an argument over who deserves praise while the need for treatment remains the central practical question.

What has changed since then should be examined against that original record. What has not changed is the need to distinguish an established event from the hopes or fears attached to it.
